// Fast input/output
struct FastReader {
    string buf;
    int idx, len;
    
    FastReader() : idx(0), len(0) {
        buf.resize(10000);
        len = buf.size();
    }
    
    char getChar() {
        if (idx >= len) {
            len = fread(buf.data(), 1, 10000, stdin);
            idx = 0;
        }
        return buf[idx++];
    }
    
    char skip() {
        char c;
        while ((c = getChar()) && (c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r'));
        return c;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int x = 0, sign = 1;
        char c = skip();
        if (c == '-') sign = -1;
        else x = c - '0';
        while ((c = getChar()) && c >= '0' && c <= '9') x = x * 10 + c - '0';
        return x * sign;
    }
    
    ll nextLong() {
        ll x = 0, sign = 1;
        char c = skip();
        if (c == '-') sign = -1;
        else x = c - '0';
        while ((c = getChar()) && c >= '0' && c <= '9') x = x * 10 + c - '0';
        return x * sign;
    }
    
    string next() {
        string res = "";
        char c = skip();
        while (c && c != ' ' && c != '\n' && c != '\r') {
            res += c;
            c = getChar();
        }
        return res;
    }
};

FastReader sc;

ll dp[105][25][11];

void fill_dp() {
    memset(dp, -1, sizeof(dp));
}

ll go(const string& A, int i, int pv, int v) {
    if (i == A.length()) {
        if (pv == 0)
            return 1;
        return 0;
    }
    if (dp[i][pv][v] != -1)
        return dp[i][pv][v];
    
    ll ans = 0;
    if (A[i] == '_') {
        for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
            if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
            int y = pv * 10 + j;
            y %= 25;
            ans += go(A, i + 1, y, v);
        }
    } else if (A[i] == 'X') {
        if (v != 10) {
            ans += go(A, i + 1, (pv * 10 + v) % 25, v);
        } else {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                int y = pv * 10 + j;
                y %= 25;
                ans += go(A, i + 1, y, j);
            }
        }
    } else {
        ans += go(A, i + 1, (pv * 10 + (A[i] - '0')) % 25, v);
    }
    
    return dp[i][pv][v] = ans;
}

                return 0;
